PUBLIC ROAD OF ANY FUNCTIONAL CLASSIFICATION OR ALLEY
Maximum height of ground cover in this zone is two feet (2’).

Can be used in medians, growth rate is slow and roots have not proven to be issues when planted in medians and/or
parking lot aisles.

Not to be used in medians and/or parking lots where canopy clearences for vehicles is necessary. Use in areas where
tree and canopy can spread. Lateral right of ways, wide medians with no sight restrictions can be ideal locations.
